title: Foreground RecordingService (microphone type) with notification
description: Keep recording alive when the screen is off or the app is in background (goal 1) by running the controller inside a foreground service of type microphone (required from Android 14).
steps: Manifest: add permissions `FOREGROUND_SERVICE`, `FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE`, `POST_NOTIFICATIONS`, `WAKE_LOCK`, and `<service android:name=".service.RecordingService" android:exported="false" android:foregroundServiceType="microphone" />`.

Create `service/RecordingService.kt`: `class RecordingService : Service()` with `private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Main.immediate)`. `onBind` returns null. Companion: `const val ACTION_START = "com.convoscribe.START"`, `ACTION_STOP = "com.convoscribe.STOP"`, `fun startIntent(context)`, `fun stopIntent(context)`.

`onStartCommand`: for ACTION_START create the notification channel `recording` (IMPORTANCE_LOW, name "Recording"), call `ServiceCompat.startForeground(this, 1, notification, ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MICROPHONE)` (the type argument is ignored below API 29 by ServiceCompat), acquire a partial `WakeLock` (tag `ConvoScribe:recording`), then `container.recordingController.start(scope)`. For ACTION_STOP: `scope.launch { controller.stop(); releaseWakeLock(); stopForeground(STOP_FOREGROUND_REMOVE); stopSelf() }`. Return `START_NOT_STICKY`.

Notification: small icon `R.drawable.ic_launcher_foreground`, title "Recording", text "Tap to open ConvoScribe", ongoing, content intent opening `MainActivity` (`PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE`), and an action "Stop" with a `PendingIntent.getService` for ACTION_STOP.
Also observe `controller.state`: if phase becomes IDLE with an `error` while the service is running, release the wake lock, stop foreground and `stopSelf()`.
`onDestroy`: release wake lock and cancel scope.

Add a small pure helper `service/RecordingNotificationText.kt`: `fun recordingNotificationText(elapsedMs: Long): String` returning `"Recording – mm:ss"` (hh:mm:ss when ≥ 1 h) and update the notification text from the state flow at most once per second. Unit-test that helper.
acceptanceCriteria: `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` declares the service with `foregroundServiceType="microphone"` and the 5 permissions
`lintDebug` reports no errors about foreground service types or missing permissions
`source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` exits 0
notes: The service is not unit-tested beyond the helper (starting it would load the native library).
